::: {.hero-bio}
I'm a scouting apprentice at Prep Baseball GA, where I take a data-driven approach to evaluating amateur players and write scouting reports on standout players for publication. Before that I was a baseball operations intern at The Team and at Major League Baseball, where my work included salary arbitration and player development. I graduated from Washington University in St. Louis (Olin Business School) in May 2026 with a BSBA in Finance and minors in Business Analytics and the Business of Sports.
:::
